# Civ VI Full-Anthology Reference — Vol 5: Governments, Policies, Governors, Religion & Great People

<!-- generated by Stage 2 reference build, 2026-08-03 -->
> **Game configuration this volume describes:** RULESET_EXPANSION_2 (Gathering
> Storm ruleset, which includes all Rise & Fall content) + every official DLC
> pack. Optional game modes (Heroes, Secret Societies, Monopolies, Barbarian
> Clans, Apocalypse, Zombies, etc.) are **not** included — the live capture
> calibration shows they are off in this game. Scenario-only content excluded.
>
> **Sourcing:** every value is machine-extracted from the game's own data files
> (base + Expansion1 + Expansion2 XML and each DLC pack's Data XML, merged in
> the game's modinfo-declared load order). Nothing comes from model memory.
> Verified against the live game DB: 36 districts (26 specialty), 54 resources
> (34 luxuries), 7 victories, 8 governors / 48 promotions — all exact matches.
>
> **Trust order if something disagrees:** 1) the live snapshot from the
> tracker, 2) this document, 3) anything else. Mods (e.g. Real Strategy) can
> shift values; the live snapshot always wins.

## Governments

### Chiefdom
- **Stats:** slots: 1 military, 1 economic; 1 influence pts/turn (envoy at 100); +0 Diplomatic Favor/turn
- **Inherent bonus:** No Bonus.
- **Legacy bonus:** No Bonus.

### Autocracy
- **Stats:** slots: 1 military, 1 economic, 1 diplomatic, 1 wildcard; unlocked by Political Philosophy; 3 influence pts/turn (envoy at 100); +1 Diplomatic Favor/turn
- **Inherent bonus:** +1 to all yields for each government building and palace in a city.
- **Legacy bonus:** +10% Production toward Wonders.

### Classical Republic
- **Stats:** slots: 2 economic, 1 diplomatic, 1 wildcard; unlocked by Political Philosophy; 3 influence pts/turn (envoy at 100); +1 Diplomatic Favor/turn
- **Inherent bonus:** All cities with a district receive +1 Housing and +1 Amenity.
- **Legacy bonus:** +15% Great Person points.

### Oligarchy
- **Stats:** slots: 2 military, 1 economic, 1 wildcard; unlocked by Political Philosophy; 3 influence pts/turn (envoy at 100); +1 Diplomatic Favor/turn
- **Inherent bonus:** All land melee, anti-cavalry, and naval melee class units gain +4 Combat Strength.
- **Legacy bonus:** +20% Unit Experience.

### Merchant Republic
- **Stats:** slots: 1 military, 2 economic, 2 diplomatic, 1 wildcard; unlocked by Exploration; 5 influence pts/turn (envoy at 150); +2 Diplomatic Favor/turn
- **Inherent bonus:** +10% Gold in all cities with an established Governor.
- **Legacy bonus:** +15% Production toward Districts.

### Monarchy
- **Stats:** slots: 2 military, 1 economic, 1 diplomatic, 2 wildcard; unlocked by Divine Right; 5 influence pts/turn (envoy at 150); +2 Diplomatic Favor/turn
- **Inherent bonus:** +1 Housing per level of Walls. +2 Diplomatic Favor for every Renaissance Wall.
- **Legacy bonus:** +50% Influence Points.

### Theocracy
- **Stats:** slots: 2 military, 2 economic, 1 diplomatic, 1 wildcard; unlocked by Reformed Church; 5 influence pts/turn (envoy at 150); +2 Diplomatic Favor/turn
- **Inherent bonus:** +5 Religious Strength in Theological Combat. +0.5 Faith per Citizen in cities with Governors.
- **Legacy bonus:** 15% Discount on Purchases with Faith.

### Communism
- **Stats:** slots: 3 military, 3 economic, 1 diplomatic, 1 wildcard; unlocked by Class Struggle; 7 influence pts/turn (envoy at 200); +3 Diplomatic Favor/turn
- **Inherent bonus:** +0.6 Production per Citizen in cities with Governors.
- **Legacy bonus:** +10% Science.

### Democracy
- **Stats:** slots: 1 military, 3 economic, 2 diplomatic, 2 wildcard; unlocked by Suffrage; 7 influence pts/turn (envoy at 200); +3 Diplomatic Favor/turn
- **Inherent bonus:** Your Trade Routes to an Ally or Suzerain's city provide +4 Food and +4 Production for both cities. Alliance Points with all allies increase by an additional .25 per turn.
- **Legacy bonus:** 15% Discount on Purchases with Gold.

### Fascism
- **Stats:** slots: 4 military, 1 economic, 1 diplomatic, 2 wildcard; unlocked by Totalitarianism; 7 influence pts/turn (envoy at 200); +3 Diplomatic Favor/turn
- **Inherent bonus:** All units gain +5 Combat Strength. War Weariness reduced by 15%.
- **Legacy bonus:** +50% Production toward Units.

### Corporate Libertarianism
- **Stats:** slots: 3 military, 1 economic, 1 diplomatic, 5 wildcard; unlocked by Venture Politics; 9 influence pts/turn (envoy at 250); +4 Diplomatic Favor/turn
- **Inherent bonus:** Commercial Hubs and Encampments provide cities with +10% Production, and accumulating resources with improvements provide +1 per turn.
- **Legacy bonus:** -10% Science.

### Digital Democracy
- **Stats:** slots: 1 military, 1 economic, 3 diplomatic, 5 wildcard; unlocked by Distributed Sovereignty; 9 influence pts/turn (envoy at 250); +4 Diplomatic Favor/turn
- **Inherent bonus:** +2 Amenities in all cities, and +2 Culture per Specialty District.
- **Legacy bonus:** -3 Combat Strength for all units.

### Synthetic Technocracy
- **Stats:** slots: 1 military, 3 economic, 1 diplomatic, 5 wildcard; unlocked by Optimization Imperative; 9 influence pts/turn (envoy at 250); +4 Diplomatic Favor/turn
- **Inherent bonus:** +3 Power in all cities, and +30% Production towards all city projects.
- **Legacy bonus:** -10% Tourism.


## Policy cards

Grouped by slot type. Each card lists its unlocking civic (or tech) and obsolescence where defined.

### Military — 40 cards

- **After Action Reports** [Rapid Deployment]: All units gain +25% combat experience.
- **Agoge** [Craftsmanship]: +50% Production toward Ancient and Classical era melee, anti-cavalry, and ranged units.
- **Bastions** [Defensive Tactics]: +6 City Defense Strength. +5 City Ranged Strength.
- **Chivalry** [Divine Right]: +50% Production toward Industrial era and earlier heavy and light cavalry units.
- **Conscription** [State Workforce]: Unit maintenance reduced by 1 Gold per turn, per unit.
- **Defense of the Motherland** [Class Struggle; exclusive to Communism]: No war weariness from combat in your territory.
- **Discipline** [Code of Laws]: +5 Unit Combat Strength when fighting Barbarians.
- **Drill Manuals** [Mercantilism]: All improved Niter and Coal resources yield 1 additional resource per turn.
- **Equestrian Orders** [Military Training]: All improved Horses and Iron resources yield 1 additional resource per turn.
- **Feudal Contract** [Feudalism]: +50% Production toward Ancient, Classical, Medieval, and Renaissance era melee, anti-cavalry, and ranged units.
- **Force Modernization** [Urbanization]: 50% Gold and resource discount on all unit upgrades.
- **Grande Armée** [Nationalism]: +50% Production toward Industrial era and earlier melee, anti-cavalry, and ranged units.
- **Integrated Space Cell** [Space Race]: +15% Production toward Space Race projects if a city has either a Military Academy or a Seaport.
- **International Waters** [Cold War]: +100% Production toward all naval units, excluding Carriers.
- **Levée en Masse** [Mobilization]: Unit maintenance cost reduced by 2 Gold per turn, per unit.
- **Lightning Warfare** [Totalitarianism]: +50% Production for all heavy and light cavalry units.
- **Limes** [Defensive Tactics]: +100% Production toward defensive buildings.
- **Limitanei** [Early Empire]: +2 Loyalty per turn for cities with a garrisoned unit.
- **Logistics** [Mercantilism]: +1 Movement if starting turn in friendly territory.
- **Maneuver** [Military Tradition]: +50% Production toward Ancient and Classical era heavy and light cavalry units.
- **Maritime Industries** [Foreign Trade]: +100% Production toward Ancient and Classical era naval units.
- **Martial Law** [Totalitarianism; exclusive to Fascism]: Accumulate 25% less war weariness than usual. +2 Loyalty per turn for cities with a garrisoned unit.
- **Military First** [Rapid Deployment]: +50% Production toward all melee, anti-cavalry, and ranged units.
- **Military Research** [Urbanization]: Military Academies, Seaports, and Renaissance Walls generate +2 Science.
- **National Identity** [Nationalism]: Units have 50% less Combat Strength reduction from being injured.
- **Native Conquest** [Colonialism]: Combat victories over units from earlier eras provide Gold equal to 50% of the Combat Strength of the defeated unit. (on Standard Speed)
- **Press Gangs** [Exploration]: 100% Production toward Industrial era and earlier naval units.
- **Professional Army** [Mercenaries]: 50% discount on all unit upgrades.
- **Propaganda** [Mass Media]: Accumulate 25% less war weariness than usual.
- **Raid** [Military Training]: Yields gained from pillaging and coastal raids are +50%.
- **Retainers** [Civil Service]: +1 Amenity for cities with a garrisoned unit.
- **Retinues** [Mercenaries]: 50% resource discount on all unit upgrades.
- **Sack** [Mercenaries]: Yields gained from pillaging are doubled for pillaging districts.
- **Second Strike Capability** [Cold War]: Nuclear Device maintenance reduced by 50% Gold per turn.
- **Strategic Air Force** [Globalization]: +50% Production toward all air units and toward Carriers.
- **Survey** [Code of Laws]: Double experience for recon units.
- **Their Finest Hour** [Suffrage; exclusive to Democracy]: +50% Production toward Modern and Atomic air units.
- **Total War** [Scorched Earth]: Yields gained from pillaging, coastal raids, and plundering Trade Routes are +50%.
- **Veterancy** [Military Training]: +30% Production toward Encampment districts and buildings for that district.
- **Wars of Religion** [Reformed Church]: +4 Combat Strength when a non-religious unit fights a civilization that follows another Religion.

- **Aesthetics** [Medieval Faires]: +100% Theater Square district adjacency bonuses.
- **Caravansaries** [Foreign Trade]: +2 Gold from all Trade Routes.
- **Civil Prestige** [Civil Service]: Established Governors with at least 2 Promotions provide +1 Amenity and +2 Housing.

- **Online Communities** [Social Media]: +50% Tourism output to civilizations to which you have a Trade Route.

- **Sports Media** [Professional Sports]: +100% Theater Square district adjacency bonuses, and Stadiums generate +1 Amenity.
- **Third Alternative** [Totalitarianism; exclusive to Fascism]: +4 Gold from each Research Lab, Military Academy, and Power Plant.

- **Trade Confederation** [Mercenaries]: +1 Culture and +1 Science from international Trade Routes.

### Diplomatic — 15 cards

- **Charismatic Leader** [Political Philosophy]: +2 Influence points per turn toward earning city-state Envoys.
- **Collective Activism** [Social Media]: +5% Culture per city-state you are the Suzerain of.
- **Communications Office** [Social Media]: Governors provide +1 Loyalty per turn to their city, per Promotion the Governor has.
- **Containment** [Cold War]: Each Envoy you send to a city-state counts as two, if its Suzerain has a different government than you.
- **Cryptography** [Cold War]: Enemy Spy level reduced by 2 in your lands. Your Spy level is increased by 1 for offensive operations.
- **Diplomatic League** [Political Philosophy]: The first Envoy you send to each city-state counts as two Envoys.
- **Gunboat Diplomacy** [Totalitarianism]: Open Borders with all city-states, and +4 Influence points per turn toward earning Envoys.
- **International Space Agency** [Globalization]: +5% Science per city-state you are the Suzerain of.
- **Machiavellianism** [Diplomatic Service]: +50% Production toward Spies. Spy operations take 25% less time.
- **Merchant Confederation** [Medieval Faires]: +1 Gold from each of your Envoys at city-states.
- **Music Censorship** [Space Race]: Rock Bands from other players may not enter your territory. -1 Amenity in all of your cities with 10 or more Population.
- **Nuclear Espionage** [Nuclear Program]: Spies who steal a tech boost without being detected gain an extra boost.
- **Praetorium** [Recorded History]: Governors provide +2 Loyalty per turn to their city.
- **Raj** [Colonialism]: +2 Science, Culture, Faith, and Gold from each city-state you are Suzerain of.
- **Wisselbanken** [Diplomatic Service]: Your Trade Routes to an Ally's city or vassal city-state provide +2 Food and +2 Production for both cities. Alliance Points with all allies increase by an additional .25 per turn.

## Governors (8) and promotions (48)

### Victor — The Castellan
- **Stats:** identity pressure 8; turns to establish 150
- **Base ability:** Military focused, once established in a city, Victor is instrumental in strengthening, preserving, and defending it from foreign threats.
- **Redoubt** (level 0 — BASE): Increases city garrison Combat Strength by +5. Establishes in 3 turns.
- **Garrison Commander** (level 1) (requires Redoubt): Units defending within the city's territory get +5 Combat Strength. Your other cities within 9 tiles gain +4 Loyalty per turn towards your civilization.
- **Defense Logistics** (level 1) (requires Redoubt): City cannot be put under siege. Accumulating Strategic resources in the city gain an additional +1 per turn.
- **Embrasure** (level 2) (requires Defense Logistics, Garrison Commander): City gains an additional Ranged Strike per turn. Military units trained in this city start with a free promotion that do not already start with a free promotion.
- **Air Defense Initiative** (level 3) (requires Embrasure): +25 Combat Strength to anti-air support units within the city's territory when defending against aircraft and ICBMs.
- **Arms Race Proponent** (level 3) (requires Embrasure): 30% Production increase to all nuclear armament projects in the city.

### Amani — The Diplomat
- **Stats:** identity pressure 8; turns to establish 100
- **Base ability:** Skilled in gaining support for your civilization, and spreading its influence to nearby cities. Amani is the only governor that can be given foreign assignment in a city-state.
- **Messenger** (level 0 — BASE): Can be assigned to a city-state, where she acts as 2 Envoys.
- **Emissary** (level 1) (requires Messenger): Other cities within 9 tiles and not owned by you lose 2 Loyalty per turn.
- **Local Informants** (level 2) (requires Emissary): Enemy Spies operate at 3 levels below normal in this city.
- **Affluence** (level 1) (requires Messenger): While established in a city-state, provides a copy of its Luxury resources to you.
- **Foreign Investor** (level 2) (requires Affluence): While established in a city-state, accumulate its Strategic resources. When suzerain receive double the amount of accumulated strategic resources.
- **Puppeteer** (level 3) (requires Local Informants, Foreign Investor): While established in a city-state, doubles the number of Envoys you have there.

### Moksha — The Cardinal
- **Stats:** identity pressure 8; turns to establish 100
- **Base ability:** Spiritual and Religious leader that can increase the Religious Strength of a city, and the Religious units stationed there. Moksha is a beacon of Faith in your empire.
- **Bishop** (level 0 — BASE): Religious pressure to adjacent cities is 100% stronger from this city. +2 Faith for every specialty district in this city.
- **Grand Inquisitor** (level 1) (requires Bishop): +10 Religious Strength in theological combat in tiles of this city.
- **Laying On Of Hands** (level 1) (requires Bishop): All Governor's units heal fully in one turn in tiles of this city.
- **Citadel of God** (level 2) (requires Grand Inquisitor, Laying On Of Hands): City ignores religious pressure from Religions not founded by the Governor's player. Gain Faith equal to 25% of the construction cost when finishing buildings.
- **Patron Saint** (level 3) (requires Citadel of God): Apostles and Warrior Monks trained in the city receive 1 extra promotion when receiving their first promotion.
- **Divine Architect** (level 3) (requires Citadel of God): Allows city to purchase districts with Faith.

### Magnus — The Steward
- **Stats:** identity pressure 8; turns to establish 100
- **Base ability:** Enterprising and capable, Magnus is able to procure valuable resources when needed. He is also quite skilled in optimizing the overall Production in the city.
- **Groundbreaker** (level 0 — BASE): +50% yields from plot harvests and feature removals in city.
- **Surplus Logistics** (level 1) (requires Groundbreaker): +20% Growth in the city. Your Trade Routes ending here provide +2 Food to their starting city.
- **Provision** (level 1) (requires Groundbreaker): Settlers trained in the city do not consume a Population.
- **Industrialist** (level 2) (requires Surplus Logistics): Increases the Power provided by each resource of the Coal Power Plant, Oil Power Plant, and Nuclear Power Plant by 1 and the Production by +2.
- **Black Marketeer** (level 2) (requires Provision): Strategic resource costs for units are discounted 80%.
- **Vertical Integration** (level 3) (requires Industrialist, Black Marketeer): This city receives Production from all nearby Industrial Zone buildings with regional bonuses, not just the first.

### Liang — The Surveyor
- **Stats:** identity pressure 8; turns to establish 100
- **Base ability:** An expert in efficiency, Liang is skilled in all things related to building and construction. An expert planner, she can also supervise the development of custom improvements in the city.
- **Guildmaster** (level 0 — BASE): All Builders trained in this city will get +1 build charge.
- **Zoning Commissioner** (level 1) (requires Guildmaster): +20% Production towards constructing districts in the city.
- **Aquaculture** (level 1) (requires Guildmaster): Can construct the Fishery improvement. +1 Food, +0.5 Housing, +1 Food if adjacent to a sea resource. +1 Production if Liang is in the city.
- **Reinforced Materials** (level 2) (requires Zoning Commissioner): This city’s improvements, buildings, and districts cannot be damaged by Environmental Effects.
- **Water Works** (level 2) (requires Aquaculture): +2 Housing for every Neighborhood and Aqueduct district in this city. +1 Amenity for every Canal and Dam district in this city.
- **Parks and Recreation** (level 3) (requires Water Works, Reinforced Materials): Can construct the City Park improvement in this city. +1 Culture and +2 Appeal. +1 Amenity if adjacent to water. City Parks provide +3 Culture if Liang is in the city.

### Pingala — The Educator
- **Stats:** identity pressure 8; turns to establish 100
- **Base ability:** Pingala is focused on the cultivation of Scientific and Cultural endeavors in the city. He is also quite skilled in the attraction of Great People to his city.
- **Librarian** (level 0 — BASE): 15% increase in Science and Culture generated by the city.
- **Connoisseur** (level 1) (requires Librarian): +1 Culture per turn for each Citizen in the city.
- **Researcher** (level 1) (requires Librarian): +1 Science per turn for each Citizen in the city.
- **Grants** (level 2) (requires Connoisseur, Researcher): +100% Great People points generated per turn in the city.
- **Curator** (level 3) (requires Grants): +100% Tourism from Great Works of Art, Music, and Writing in the city.
- **Space Initiative** (level 3) (requires Grants): 30% Production increase to all space-program projects in the city.

### Reyna — The Financier
- **Stats:** identity pressure 8; turns to establish 100
- **Base ability:** Shrewd and fiscally knowledgeable, Reyna is able to strengthen the economic power of a city, using finances to provide more than is normally possible.
- **Land Acquisition** (level 0 — BASE): Acquire new tiles in city faster. +3 Gold per turn from each foreign Trade Route passing through the city.
- **Harbormaster** (level 1) (requires Land Acquisition): Double adjacency bonuses from Commercial Hubs and Harbors in the city.
- **Forestry Management** (level 1) (requires Land Acquisition): This city receives +2 Gold from each unimproved feature. Tiles adjacent to unimproved features receive +1 Appeal in this city.
- **Tax Collector** (level 2) (requires Harbormaster, Forestry Management): +2 Gold per turn for each Citizen in the city.
- **Renewable Subsidizer** (level 3) (requires Tax Collector): All Offshore Wind Farms, Solar Farms, Wind Farms, Geothermal Plants, and Hydroelectric Dams in this city receive +2 Power and +2 Gold.
- **Contractor** (level 3) (requires Tax Collector): Allows city to purchase districts with Gold.

### Ibrahim — The Grand Vizier
- **Stats:** identity pressure 8; turns to establish 150
- **Base ability:** Suleiman's vizier Ibrahim, is a Military and Diplomacy focused governor. In addition to having a unique promotion tree, Ibrahim is the only Governor that can be assigned to another civilization's capital as well as any domestic city. He is well suited for influencing military operations but is also a skilled diplomat, strengthening relationships with friendly civilizations and easing tensions with rivals.
- **Pasha** (level 0 — BASE): +20% Production to all military units in the city.
- **Head Falconer** (level 1) (requires Pasha): All friendly units fighting within the city's territory gain +5 Combat Strength.
- **Serasker** (level 1) (requires Pasha): Grants all units within 10 tiles of the City Center +10 Combat Strength when attacking defensible districts.
- **Khass-Oda-Bashi** (level 2) (requires Head Falconer): When established in an allied foreign Capital, your Alliance Points with the owner increase an extra .5 per turn.
- **Capou Agha** (level 2) (requires Serasker): When established in a foreign Capital, Grievances from the city owner against you are reduced by 1 more per turn.
- **Grand Vizier** (level 3) (requires Khass-Oda-Bashi, Capou Agha): When established in a foreign Capital, none of the owner's cities exert Loyalty pressure on your cities.


## Religion

### Beliefs — 59 total, by class

#### Pantheon (23)

- **City Patron Goddess:** +25% Production toward districts in cities without a specialty district.
- **Dance of the Aurora:** Holy Site districts get +1 Faith from adjacent Tundra tiles.
- **Desert Folklore:** Holy Site districts get +1 Faith from adjacent Desert tiles.
- **Divine Spark:** +1 Great Person point from Holy Site (Prophet), Campus (Scientist), and Theater Square (Writer) districts.
- **Earth Goddess:** +1 Faith from tiles with Charming or better Appeal.
- **Fertility Rites:** City growth rate is 10% higher.
- **Fire Goddess:** +2 Faith from Geothermal Fissures and Volcanic Soil.
- **God of Craftsmen:** +1 Production from Mines over Strategic resources.
- **God of Healing:** Increases Healing by +30 in your Holy Site district, or any adjacent tiles.
- **God of War:** Bonus Faith equal to 50% of the strength of each combat unit killed within 8 tiles of a Holy Site district. (on Standard Speed)
- **God of the Forge:** +25% Production toward Ancient and Classical military units.
- **God of the Open Sky:** +1 Culture from Pastures.
- **God of the Sea:** +1 Production from Fishing Boats.
- **Goddess of Festivals:** +1 Food from Wine, Incense, Cocoa, Tobacco, Olives, Coffee, and Tea Plantations.
- **Goddess of the Hunt:** +1 Food from Camps.
- **Initiation Rites:** +50 Faith for each Barbarian Outpost dispersed.
- **Lady of the Reeds and Marshes:** +1 Production from Marsh, Oasis, and Floodplains.
- **Monument to the Gods:** +15% Production towards Ancient and Classical era wonders.
- **Religious Idols:** +2 Faith from Mines over Luxury and Bonus resources.
- **Religious Settlements:** Border expansion rate is 15% higher.
- **River Goddess:** +1 Amenity to cities if they have a Holy Site district adjacent to a River.
- **Sacred Path:** Holy Site districts get +1 Faith from adjacent Rainforest tiles.
- **Stone Circles:** +2 Faith from Quarries.

#### Founder (9)

- **Cross-Cultural Dialogue:** +1 Science for every 5 followers of this Religion in other civilizations.
- **Lay Ministry:** Each Holy Site or Theater Square district in a city following this Religion provides +1 Faith or +1 Culture respectively.
- **Papal Primacy:** When you send an Envoy to a City-State it adds 200 Religious pressure to that City-State.
- **Pilgrimage:** +2 Faith for every city following this Religion in other civilizations and City-States.
- **Religious Unity:** +1 Envoy at each City-State when it first adopts this Religion, in addition to any envoy from a City-State quest.
- **Sacred Places:** +2 Science, Culture, Gold, and Faith for each city following this Religion that has a World Wonder.
- **Stewardship:** Each Campus or Commercial Hub district in a city following this Religion provides +1 Science or +1 Gold respectively.
- **Tithe:** +1 Gold for every 4 followers of this Religion.
- **World Church:** +1 Culture for every 5 followers of this Religion in other civilizations.

#### Follower (9)

- **Choral Music:** Shrines and Temples provide Culture equal to their intrinsic Faith output.
- **Divine Inspiration:** All world wonders provide +4 Faith.
- **Feed the World:** Shrines and Temples provide Food equal to their intrinsic Faith output.
- **Jesuit Education:** May purchase Campus and Theater Square district buildings with Faith.
- **Religious Community:** Shrines and Temples each provide +1 Housing.
- **Reliquaries:** Relics have triple yield of both Faith and Tourism.
- **Warrior Monks:** Allows spending Faith to train Warrior Monks, medieval land combat units with a unique promotion tree. May only be purchased in a city with a Temple in its Holy Site.
- **Work Ethic:** +1% Production for each citizen following this religion in the city.
- **Zen Meditation:** +1 Amenity in cities with 2 specialty districts.

#### Enhancer (9)

- **Crusade:** Combat units gain +10 Combat Strength when within the borders of foreign cities that follow this Religion.
- **Defender of the Faith:** Combat units gain +5 Combat Strength when within the borders of friendly cities that follow this Religion.
- **Holy Order:** Missionaries and Apostles are 30% cheaper to purchase.
- **Holy Waters:** Increases Healing of your religious units by +10 in Holy Site districts belonging to cities with your majority religion, or any adjacent tiles.
- **Itinerant Preachers:** Religion spreads to cities 30% further away.
- **Missionary Zeal:** Religious units ignore Movement costs of terrain and features.
- **Monastic Isolation:** Your Religion's pressure never drops due to losses in Theological Combat.
- **Religious Colonization:** Cities start with this Religion in place if founded by a player who has this as their majority Religion.
- **Scripture:** Religious spread from adjacent city pressure is 25% stronger. Boosted to 50% once Printing is researched.

#### Worship (9)

- **Cathedral:** Allows construction of Cathedrals (+3 Faith, 1 slot for religious art).
- **Dar-e Mehr:** Allows construction of Dar-e Mehrs (+3 Faith, +1 additional for each era since constructed or last repaired).
- **Gurdwara:** Allows construction of Gurdwaras (+3 Faith, +2 Food).
- **Meeting House:** Allows construction of Meeting Houses (+3 Faith, +2 Production).
- **Mosque:** Allows construction of Mosques (+3 Faith). Missionaries and Apostles +1 Spread.
- **Pagoda:** Allows construction of Pagodas (+3 Faith, +1 Housing).
- **Stupa:** Allows construction of Stupas (+3 Faith, +1 Amenity).
- **Synagogue:** Allows construction of Synagogues (+5 Faith).
- **Wat:** Allows construction of Wats (+3 Faith, +2 Science).

### Religions available to found: 24 named religions (name choice is cosmetic; a custom name is also allowed).


## Great People

### Classes

- **Great General** — points from PSEUDOYIELD_GPP_GENERAL; district: Encampment
- **Great Admiral** — points from PSEUDOYIELD_GPP_ADMIRAL; district: Harbor
- **Great Engineer** — points from PSEUDOYIELD_GPP_ENGINEER; district: Industrial Zone
- **Great Merchant** — points from PSEUDOYIELD_GPP_MERCHANT; district: Commercial Hub
- **Great Prophet** — points from PSEUDOYIELD_GPP_PROPHET; district: Holy Site
- **Great Scientist** — points from PSEUDOYIELD_GPP_SCIENTIST; district: Campus
- **Great Writer** — points from PSEUDOYIELD_GPP_WRITER; district: Theater Square
- **Great Artist** — points from PSEUDOYIELD_GPP_ARTIST; district: Theater Square
- **Great Musician** — points from PSEUDOYIELD_GPP_MUSICIAN; district: Theater Square
- **Comandante General** — points from PSEUDOYIELD_GPP_GENERAL; district: Encampment

- **Alfred Nobel** (Modern): on activation: Triggers the Eureka moment for 1 random technology from the Modern or Atomic era. Applies 100 free Great People points towards recruiting all current and future Great People. (1 charge)
- **Erwin Schrödinger** (Atomic): on activation: Triggers the Eureka moment for 3 random technologies from the Atomic or Information era. (1 charge)
- **Janaki Ammal** (Atomic): on activation: Gain 400 Science for each Rainforest tile here or adjacent. (1 charge)
- **Margaret Mead** (Atomic): on activation: Grants 1000 Science and Culture (on Standard speed). (1 charge)
- **Mary Leakey** (Atomic): on activation: Artifacts in all your cities generate 300% of their normal Tourism. Gain 350 Science for every Artifact in this city. (1 charge)
- **Abdus Salam** (Information): on activation: Triggers the Eureka moment for all technologies from the Information era. (1 charge)
- **Carl Sagan** (Information): on activation: Grants 3000 Production towards Space Race project construction. (1 charge)
- **Stephanie Kwolek** (Information): on activation: +100% Production towards Space Race projects. (1 charge)
